seeds.title: summon from an editor
seeds.intent: Summoning must make input ready while preserving the previously focused editor target identity.
seeds.capture_question: Where does focus go, what query state is shown, and is the editor identity preserved after dismissal?

seeds.title: rapid typing and backspace
seeds.intent: Query ordering, loading and selection must prevent an old query from overwriting the current one.
seeds.capture_question: What results/selection appear during rapid edits, and can a late response replace the current query?

seeds.title: exact alias versus frequent item
seeds.intent: Ranking must be captured and then implemented deterministically, without assuming an unobserved scoring rule.
seeds.capture_question: When an exact alias and a frequent item both match, which ranks first and what tie-break applies?

seeds.title: child view to actions to Escape
seeds.intent: Nested views and Escape must unwind one layer at a time and restore parent state.
seeds.capture_question: Which layer does each Escape close, and are parent selection and scroll restored?

seeds.title: IME confirm and cancel
seeds.intent: IME composition must not cause accidental execution or dismissal.
seeds.capture_question: While marked text owns the field, what do Enter and Escape do to composition, results and the window?

seeds.title: copy while clipboard chooser is open
seeds.intent: Clipboard generations must prevent an old chooser selection from overwriting a new user copy.
seeds.capture_question: What clipboard generation is recorded, and what happens when an external copy occurs before paste?

seeds.title: paste after target exits
seeds.intent: A paste must never land in an unrelated window when the original target exits.
seeds.capture_question: What error or fallback appears, and can any synthetic input reach another foreground window?

seeds.title: permission revoked mid-command
seeds.intent: A revoked filesystem permission must fail safely with actionable recovery.
seeds.capture_question: What state/message appears when a scoped root becomes unreadable during search or action?

seeds.title: window moved to another DPI monitor
seeds.intent: Geometry must remain valid and proportional across mixed-DPI displays.
seeds.capture_question: How do bounds, scale and restore behavior change when moved to another DPI monitor?

seeds.title: file renamed or deleted during search
seeds.intent: A stale file result must fail clearly or refresh without acting on a substituted path.
seeds.capture_question: What happens to the selected result and action when the file is renamed or deleted after indexing?

seeds.title: local note crash during save
seeds.intent: The last acknowledged edit must be recoverable after a crash during save.
seeds.capture_question: Which content is durable after a kill during write, and what recovery surface appears?

seeds.title: extension crash or infinite loop
seeds.intent: A faulty worker must not freeze the core launcher and must be quarantined.
seeds.capture_question: What stays responsive, what worker lifetime remains, and what quarantine/retry UI appears?

seeds.title: OAuth denial and token expiry
seeds.intent: Denial and expiry must be recoverable without leaking tokens.
seeds.capture_question: What messages and retry/re-authorize paths appear on denial and expiry?

seeds.title: script arguments with spaces and metacharacters
seeds.intent: Arguments must remain literal argv values, never shell syntax.
seeds.capture_question: What argv does the target script receive for spaces, quotes, ampersands and command substitution?

seeds.title: sleep, wake and locked session
seeds.intent: Lifecycle transitions must not replay input or duplicate effects.
seeds.capture_question: Which hotkeys, jobs and captures resume after wake or unlock, and are effects duplicated?

seeds.title: interrupted update
seeds.intent: After interruption, either the previous version or a verified new version must start.
seeds.capture_question: What starts after a kill at each update phase, and what recovery state is shown?

seeds.title: offline concurrent sync edits
seeds.intent: Concurrent offline edits and deletions must not be silently lost.
seeds.capture_question: What conflict/deletion behavior appears when two offline devices edit the same object?

seeds.title: revoked sync device
seeds.intent: A revoked device must be denied future access with the historical-data limit stated.
seeds.capture_question: What future reads/writes are denied, and how is the old-data limitation communicated?

seeds.title: AI tool with injected instructions
seeds.intent: Untrusted content cannot expand the authority granted to an AI tool.
seeds.capture_question: What authority does the tool request, and can injected content widen data access or side effects?

seeds.title: Wayland unavailable capability
seeds.intent: An unavailable platform capability must be represented accurately with a degraded fallback. The original Wayland case is outside Windows/macOS F01 scope, so S24-WIN and S24-MAC carry the degraded-capability intent while S20 stays in the denominator.
seeds.capture_question: What capability is unavailable, what fallback remains, and is the unsupported state stated truthfully?
